name: Keyboard vs. Mouse
instruction: Compare a keyboard and a mouse in terms of their design. The keyboard should be rectangular with a full set of keys, while the mouse should be ergonomic and fit comfortably in the hand.

Shape accuracy: The keyboard is rectangular in shape.
The mouse has an ergonomic design.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The keys are proportionate to the keyboard.
Texture and surface detail: The keyboard likely has a smooth surface for key pressing.
The mouse may have a textured surface for grip.

Object distance and contact: The keyboard and mouse are separate objects.
The mouse is positioned within easy reach of the keyboard.

Instruction execution accuracy: The keyboard is accurately represented as rectangular with a full set of keys.
The mouse is accurately represented as ergonomic.
